title: CAM Assist Creation Studio Capability Request Schema
description: Portable, reference-only capability request describing what downstream machining-development assistance CAM Assist is requesting from the separate CAM-Creation-Studio product. Direction is strictly CAM Assist -> CAM-Creation-Studio (outbound, advisory). A contract-first interoperability probe: it names desired downstream analysis (feeds/speeds, tooling, sequencing, simulation, toolpath development, etc.) and points at the package's manifest, strategy, review packet, and — when available — its traceability bundle and production shop handoff. It does not own, copy, or mutate the referenced files. The request is advisory only: it does not authorize machine execution, does not bypass human review, does not confirm machine readiness, does not require G-code generation, and does not assert that CAM-Creation-Studio supports any requested capability. It introduces no CAM-Creation-Studio runtime dependency and carries no created_at (the artifact is deterministic and reproducible; regeneration is byte-identical). Structural validation does not require the referenced files to exist (existence is an opt-in completeness concern).

record_version.description: Semantic version of the request record FORMAT.

package_reference.description: Reference to the package this request concerns. Accepts federated_package_id, relative path, or package directory name.

request_direction.description: Must be 'cam_assist_to_creation_studio'. The seam is outbound only; no inbound authority is ever expressed.

requested_capabilities.description: Non-empty, unique list of requested downstream capabilities from the v1 vocabulary. Describes requested assistance only; does not guarantee CAM-Creation-Studio supports the capability.

contents.description: Map of references to the package artifacts this request concerns, resolved relative to the request file's own location. References are navigational only; the referenced files remain authoritative and are never owned, copied, or mutated. Only the known slots below are permitted; no individual slot is required.

strategy_file.description: Reference to the package strategy file.

review_packet_file.description: Reference to the package review packet.

traceability_bundle_file.description: Reference to the traceability bundle (CAM-A19), included when available.

production_shop_handoff_file.description: Reference to the production shop handoff (CAM-A20), included when available. Distinct from the request itself: the handoff remains a separate outbound artifact.

request_context.description: Optional, informational-only context for the request. No field grants authority or changes validity. Closed to the known fields below.

machine_profile.description: Informational machine profile reference, or null when unspecified.

operator_notes.description: Informational free-text notes for the downstream reviewer.

authority.description: Informational authority constraints. REQUIRED on a request. Every flag MUST be true.

is_informational.description: MUST be true. This record is informational only.

does_not_authorize_execution.description: MUST be true. This record does not authorize machine execution.

does_not_bypass_human_review.description: MUST be true. This record does not bypass required human review.

does_not_confirm_machine_readiness.description: MUST be true. This request does NOT assert that the package is machine-ready.

does_not_require_gcode_generation.description: MUST be true. This request does not require or authorize G-code generation inside CAM Assist.
